## Essay summaries
### Can You Cook?
URL: https://bamcphail.github.io/can-you-cook.html · md: https://bamcphail.github.io/can-you-cook.md
Thesis: Product management is not a rotating skills checklist (SQL, AI fluency, sales, etc.). The question that matters is whether a PM can deliver outcomes — create something from signal, align teams under pressure, and own results. Metaphor: cooks / The Bear — firemen who run toward the hard problems.

### The Hybrid Operator
URL: https://bamcphail.github.io/the-hybrid-operator.html · md: https://bamcphail.github.io/the-hybrid-operator.md
Thesis: The best go-to-market product teams in 2026 are hybrid operators who move between product, GTM, and building without waiting for permission.

### Signal is the Bottleneck
URL: https://bamcphail.github.io/signal-is-the-bottleneck.html · md: https://bamcphail.github.io/signal-is-the-bottleneck.md
Thesis: The scarce resource in product work is signal — what actually matters in the market — not more process, tools, or headcount.

### The Future of Product Development
URL: https://bamcphail.github.io/future-of-product-development.html · md: https://bamcphail.github.io/future-of-product-development.md
Thesis: AI is rewriting how teams build and collapsing distance between PM, eng, design, and GTM; the craft still centers on judgment and delivery.

### TeamRoom
URL: https://bamcphail.github.io/team-room.html · md: https://bamcphail.github.io/team-room.md
Thesis: TeamRoom is a PM operating system for how to run a team and ship work.
